adjudications.question: Is the accent beside the segol under ת in בֵּיתֶךָ a tipcha?
What accent is printed under תִּ in the first וְנָתַתִּי?
adjudications.encoding: Replace provisional U+05A5 merkha with U+05A7 darga.

adjudications.question: Are short ticks immediately following הָאֲדָמָה and the Divine Name paseq marks?
adjudications.encoding: Do not add any paseq marks.

adjudications.question: First or second lamed carries the meteg?
Alef or lamed carries the meteg in the first אלהיכם?
adjudications.encoding: אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם; supersedes independent tentative alef reading.
